title: Presidential candidates face heavy schedule of interviews and Q&A sessions this Friday (11)
subtitle: Candidates for the presidency participate in interviews, Q&A sessions, and campaign rallies this Friday, September 11.
excerpt: This Friday (11), presidential candidates continue their campaigns with interviews, Q&A sessions, TV recordings, and participation in rallies.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The schedule for the presidential candidates this Friday (11) includes interviews and Q&A sessions with media outlets, recordings for television broadcasts, and participation in campaign rallies.

Friday's Schedule

  • Q&A sessions with various broadcasters.
  • Interviews granted to media outlets.
  • Recordings for television programs.
  • Participation in campaign rallies.

These activities are part of the campaign routine for the presidential candidates, who alternate between media appearances and in-person events throughout the aforementioned date.

With information from Agência Brasil.
